titleTr: B1 tekrar: zamanlar ve substitute başvurusu

explainTr: Doğru zamanı seçmenin sırrı ipucu kelimelerde: 'last week, in 2019, yesterday' → past simple. 'since, for, yet, already, ever' → present perfect. 'while, when ... was doing' → past continuous. 'tomorrow, next week, I'm going to' → future.
Past simple biten bir olayı, present perfect hâlâ süren ya da şimdiyle bağlantılı bir olayı anlatır: I lived in Isparta (artık orada değilim). I have lived in the U.S. since 2019 (hâlâ buradayım).
Past continuous bir eylemin sürdüğü sırada başka bir şeyin olduğunu gösterir: I was filling out the form when the phone rang. Başvuru yazılarında bu üç zamanı birlikte kullanırsın.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'yaşadım / yaşıyorum / yaşamışım' gibi tek bir fiilin ekleri zamanı gösterir. İngilizcede yardımcı fiil seçersin: lived, have lived, was living, will live. Türkçede 'beri' ve 'için' için tek kalıp var; İngilizcede since (başlangıç), for (süre) ayrımı yapılır.

reading.title: Hafsa's application
reading.text:
Hafsa has wanted to be a substitute teacher for a long time. Last month, she found the school district website and started her application. First, she created an account. While she was filling out the form, Emre helped her with some difficult words. She uploaded her resume and described her experience. In Turkey, she helped at her neighborhood school, and she has been reading with children at the library since March. She also attached a reference from Mr. Brown.

The form asked about qualifications. The district requires a high school diploma and a substitute certificate. Hafsa has her diploma, and she is taking an online class for the certificate. She will finish the class in December.

Last week, an email arrived. "We have received your application," it said. "Please come for your fingerprints and a background check on Monday." Hafsa was excited, but she was also nervous. She has never done a background check before. On Monday she is going to take her passport and two forms to the district office. "I am going to arrive early," she told Linda. "Maybe I will get a job offer by spring!"

Her application is not perfect, but she did her best. She knows that being available, patient, and ready to learn is important, and she believes the next step will be easier than the first one.

writing.promptTr: Vekil öğretmenlik başvurusu için kısa bir tanıtım paragrafı yaz: geçmişin, şimdiki durumun ve gelecek planın (100-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write a short paragraph for a substitute teacher application: your past, your present and your plans (100-120 words).
writing.model: My name is Hafsa, and I am from Isparta, Turkey. I moved to the United States in 2019. Last year I started volunteering at the public library, and I have been reading with children there since March. I enjoy working with young students, and I am very patient. I am also taking an online class for my substitute certificate. I will finish it in December. I am available every weekday, and I can start immediately. While I was preparing this application, I learned a lot about American schools. In the future, I would like to become a reliable substitute teacher at Lincoln Elementary.
checklistTr: Geçmiş (past simple), 'since/for' ile present perfect ve gelecek (will / going to) cümlelerinin hepsi var mı?
Zamanlar doğru seçildi mi (since + başlangıç, for + süre)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
